title: The Exact Welfare Guarantee of Fixed-Price Bilateral Trade
abstract: arXiv:2609.35888v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A seller and a buyer with independent private values can trade only at a posted price. We determine the worst case of this mechanism exactly: the best posted price always guarantees a $\beta_*=0.738024...$ fraction of first-best welfare, where $\beta_*$ is the root of an explicit equation, the worst-case buyer is unique up to scaling, and no pair of distributions attains the worst case. This closes the gap $[0.7292,0.73805]$ left by a line of work from SODA 2016 through two STOC 2023 papers and AAAI 2026. The proof is an explicit certificate of optimality: after one change of variables, the gap between the optimal value and that of any buyer distribution is a sum of nonnegative integrals, as in a linear-programming dual, and equality identifies the worst-case shape. translated_title: 固定价格双边贸易的精确福利保证
translated_abstract: 一位具有独立私人估值的卖方和买方只能按照一个公布的价格进行交易。我们精确地确定了这种机制的最坏情形：最优公布价格总能保证不低于最优福利的 β* = 0.738024... 比例，其中 β* 是某个显式方程的根；最坏情形下的买方分布在缩放意义下是唯一的，且没有任何一对分布能够达到最坏情形。这填补了从 SODA 2016 到两篇 STOC 2023 论文以及 AAAI 2026 的一系列工作所遗留的区间 [0.7292, 0.73805] 的空白。证明是一个显式的最优性证书：经过一次变量替换之后，最优值与任何买方分布所得值之间的差距可以表示为若干非负积分之和（如同线性规划对偶一样），而等号成立时即确定了最坏情形的形状。该证书还给出了贸易收益与卖方初始福利之间的完整权衡：当最优贸易收益占……的比例为 κ 时（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文精确确定了固定价格双边贸易中最优公布价格所能保证的最坏情形福利比例 β* ≈ 0.738024，给出了显式的最优性证书，并刻画了贸易收益与卖方初始福利之间的完整权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper exactly determines the worst-case welfare guarantee of the best posted price in fixed-price bilateral trade as β* ≈ 0.738024, provides an explicit certificate of optimality, and characterizes the complete tradeoff between gains from trade and the seller's initial welfare.
